title: Yi Jian Mei (xue hua piao piao bei feng xiao xiao)

lines.text: 真情像草原广阔
lines.translation: True love is as vast as the grasslands

lines.text: 层层风雨不能阻隔
lines.translation: Layer upon layer of wind and rain cannot keep it apart

lines.text: 总有云开日出时候
lines.translation: There will always come a time when the clouds part and the sun rises

lines.text: 万丈阳光照耀你我
lines.translation: Boundless sunlight shining on you and me

lines.text: 真情像梅花开过
lines.translation: True love is like the plum blossom in bloom

lines.text: 冷冷冰雪不能掩没
lines.translation: Cold ice and snow cannot bury it

lines.text: 就在最冷枝头绽放
lines.translation: It blooms on the coldest branch

lines.text: 看见春天走向你我
lines.translation: Seeing spring walk toward you and me

lines.text: 雪花飘飘 北风萧萧
lines.translation: Snowflakes drifting, the north wind howling

lines.text: 天地 一片 苍茫
lines.translation: Heaven and earth, one vast expanse

lines.text: 一翦寒梅 傲立雪中
lines.translation: A sprig of winter plum stands proudly in the snow

lines.text: 只为 伊人 飘香
lines.translation: Giving its fragrance only for the one I love

lines.text: 爱我所爱 无怨无悔
lines.translation: Loving whom I love, without complaint or regret

lines.text: 此情 长留 心间
lines.translation: This love stays forever in my heart
